title: MU BURGER
subtitle: E-Ordering
description:
Digital ordering solutions for modern hospitality brands.
A custom web ordering platform developed for MU Burger, enabling seamless digital ordering experiences across different hospitality environments.
The application integrates real-time menu updates, allergen management, and multilingual support, while connecting directly with POS systems. Customers can order via QR code, pay within the application, split the bill, and manage service charges and invoices through a streamlined digital interface.
